column3: They decided to nominate her for the manager position. (他們決定提名她擔任經理職位。)
I support your decision to change your career path. (我支持你轉換職涯跑道的決定。)
The jury found him guilty of the crime. (陪審團判定他犯下該罪行。)
I have to go to court next week for jury duty. (我下週必須去法庭履行陪審員義務。)
The company will launch a new product next month. (公司下個月將推出一項新產品。)
Parking here is a violation of the building rules. (停在這裡違反了大樓規定。)
The storm caused a lot of damage to the roof. (暴風雨對屋頂造成了嚴重損害。)
The store is temporarily closed for renovations. (這家店為了裝修暫時關閉。)
She is preparing for the upcoming marathon race. (她正在為即將到來的馬拉松比賽做準備。)
I feel a lot of pressure at work this week. (我這週在工作上感到很大壓力。)
